dashboard.label: Cyber Data Catalog - Detection Health and ATT&CK Exposure
dashboard.description: Enabled is not the same as working. Confidence = data flowing + CIM normalized + BAS validated + executing without skips.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_detection_health_lookup | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_tier enabled ko_type | where enabled="yes" | chart count over ko_tier by health_state
| inputlookup dc_attack_coverage_lookup | stats count by coverage_state

panel.title: Silent Tier 0/1 detections - fired nothing in 90 days

search.query: | inputlookup dc_ko_lookup where enabled="yes" | where ko_tier="Tier 0" OR ko_tier="Tier 1" | lookup dc_detection_health_lookup ko_id OUTPUT last_fired runs_30d skip_rate_pct health_state | where runs_30d>20 AND (isnull(last_fired) OR last_fired<relative_time(now(),"-90d")) | eval days_silent=if(isnull(last_fired),999,round((now()-last_fired)/86400,0)) | table ko_id ko_name ko_tier owner app days_silent runs_30d skip_rate_pct health_state | sort ko_tier - days_silent

panel.title: Skipped executions - leading indicator of missed detections

search.query: | inputlookup dc_detection_health_lookup | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_name ko_tier owner enabled | where enabled="yes" AND skip_rate_pct>0 | table ko_id ko_name ko_tier owner runs_30d skipped_30d skip_rate_pct | sort - skip_rate_pct

panel.title: ATT&CK techniques at risk from data issues

search.query: | inputlookup dc_attack_coverage_lookup | table technique detections_total detections_healthy detections_at_risk coverage_state datasets_supporting | sort coverage_state - detections_at_risk

panel.title: ATT&CK technique detail - detections mapped to a specific technique

search.query: | inputlookup dc_attack_mapping_lookup | stats count by technique, technique_name | eval label=if(technique_name!="",technique." - ".technique_name,technique) | sort technique

| inputlookup dc_attack_mapping_lookup | search technique="$mitre_technique$" | eval technique_display=if(technique_name!="",technique." - ".technique_name,technique) | table technique_display tactic sub_technique ko_id ko_name ko_type ko_tier app owner enabled health_state data_at_risk datasets_supporting source | sort ko_tier - health_state

html.p: For the full ATT&CK technique-by-tactic coverage matrix (production and risk-accepted detections vs. the complete ctm_mitre_lookup technique set), see the MITRE ATT&CK Coverage Matrix dashboard.
